text: Corrects the claim that AC2 forces PAWL-029 to land first. It does not: AC1 and AC2 read supersession tables, PAWL-032 declares none, and its own grammar says prose mentioning a superseded criterion is not a declaration. The references to PAWL-029 are prose and a shapes table, so nothing here fails on them. I derived a consequence from criteria I had written two paragraphs earlier without checking it against them — the fourth shape in this spec's own table, in the spec that names it
